_comment: RATCHET baseline for scripts/check-monitoring-schedules.mjs. These rows violated CLAUDE.md's off-:00 boundary law at the moment the gate landed (OPS-MONITORING-SCHEDULE-SOT-W1, 2026-08-03). They REPORT; they do not block. A NEW violation blocks. A row here that moves to a DIFFERENT violating minute blocks. This file only ever SHRINKS — deleting an entry is always allowed, adding one is a deliberate edit a reviewer sees.
_why_a_baseline: A fail-closed gate + known pre-existing violations + an explicit instruction not to fix them in this wave are mutually unsatisfiable: wired as a hard block, this gate would have failed every deploy from the commit that introduced it. Same resolution the repo already runs for scripts/check_test_baseline.sh vs audits/test-baseline-known-failures.txt.

entries.note: Fires exactly ON the :00 boundary — the same defect SEC-48 raised against venue-slo-tiers-drift-canary, on a load-bearing row. Moving it is a live crontab mutation plus an inventory re-stamp, which is the sweep wave's job, not this one's. Suggested target: 27 12 * * 2 (already occupied Mondays by venue-slo; Tuesday is free).

A deliberate 15-minute grid whose LAST member, :58, sits 2 minutes before the next hour's :00. Three of its four minutes are fine; only :58 breaches. Cheapest fix is a grid shifted to 13,28,43,57 or 12,27,42,57 — but it is a live crontab change on a load-bearing canary and belongs to the sweep.

Same shape as webhook-delivery-canary: a 5-minute grid running 13..58, where only the trailing :58 breaches. Also an aoe-1 artifact, so the sweep must touch the AOE host's crontab as well as the inventory row.
